P.name: Searing Brilliance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mel's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Overwhelm'' for each instance of damage they deal to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on {{tt|subsequent damage instances|From her attacks/abilities}} and stacking infinitely.
P.description2: {{sbc|Overwhelm:}} Store {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50;60;70;80|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the affected enemy with the first stack, reduced{{ft|to 50%|to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50*0.5;60*0.5;70*0.5;80*0.5|0 to 3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.5}}% AP)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}. For each stack, store an additional {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|2;3;4;5|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}}% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the target. If the total {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} stored exceeds the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} and {{tip|shields}}, the next stack applied against them will consume them all to deal the stored damage.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Searing Brilliance:}} '''Mel's''' ability casts each generate 3 stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals {{as|{{pplevel|8 to 30}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, for a total possible damage of {{as|{{pplevel|8*9 to 30*9}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*9}}% AP)}} at maximum stacks.

Q.name: Radiant Volley
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' launches a barrage of luminous bolts at the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Time between first and last explosion}} which distribute evenly in the area. Each bolt explodes upon landing to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, with all explosions after the first dealing reduced damage.
Q.description2: The bolts momentarily grant {{tip|sight}} during their travel, while the explosions grant {{tip|sight}} over their target area. Both can see through {{tip|brush}} and [[terrain]].

W.name: Rebuttal
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' forms a protective barrier around herself for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for the duration, and gaining {{as|{{sti|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Additionally, all hostile {{tip|projectiles}} sourced from enemy {{tip|champions}} that collide with the barrier will be destroyed instantly before '''Mel''' fires the same projectiles as her own, either toward or in the direction of the {{tt|original sources|See notes}}, or {{tt|toward herself|See notes}}.
W.description2: Replicated projectiles have the {{tt|same features|See notes}} that the original ones do, but they retain a ratio of the damage that the original ones would deal. Additionally, all of their damage is converted to {{as|magic damage}}, with {{as|physical damage}} instances being reduced to 70% before conversion.
W.leveling2: {{st|Replicated Projectile Magic Damage Modifier|{{ap|40 to 60}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage|Replicated Projectile Physical Damage Modifier|{{ap|40*.7 to 60*.7}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|5*.7}}% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage}}

E.name: Solar Snare
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' fires an orb in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Can see through brush and terrain.}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds as it travels. Enemies hit by the orb are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description2: The orb emanates a field of solar radiation that additionally expands after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. Enemies within the field are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% every {{fd|0.125}} seconds, lingering for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after exiting.
E.leveling2: {{st|Field Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2 to 8}} {{as|(+ 1% AP)}}|Field Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|2*8 to 8*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1*8}}% AP)}}}}
E.description3: Both the orb and the field of ''Solar Snare'' deal {{#expr:0.5*100}}% damage against {{tip|minions}}.
E.leveling3:
{{st|Orb Minion Magic Damage|{{ap|60*0.5 to 240*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Field Minion Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|2*0.5 to 8*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1*0.5}}% AP)}}|Field Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|2*0.5*8 to 8*0.5*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1*0.5*8}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Golden Eclipse
R.leveling:
{{st|Increased Stored Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}}}}
{{st|Stored Damage Increase per Stack|{{ap|1 to 3}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' unleashes a radiant blast on all enemies affected by ''{{ai|Searing Brilliance|Mel|Overwhelm}}'', dealing {{as|magic damage}} to each of them. Enemies are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 1 second from the start of the cast time.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} (+ {{ap|4 to 10}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} per [[File:Searing Brilliance.png|20px|link=]] ''Overwhelm'' stack on the target)}}
R.description3: ''An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Searing Brilliance|Mel|Overwhelm}} is required to cast this ability.''
